entities.summary: Augusta Savage was an American sculptor associated with the Harlem Renaissance. She was also a teacher whose studio was important to the careers of a generation of artists who would become nationally known. She worked for equal rights for African Americans in the arts. Augusta Savage was a authors & novelists from Green Cove Springs (1892-02-29, Green Cove Springs–1962-03-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
